column1: # Deliberate exceptions to the install-timeout check (tracker t4456).
# One row per job that may run a package install with no timeout-minutes on
# the step or the job, with the reason it is deliberate:
# repo is `owner/name` (case-insensitive), the workflow path is relative to
# the repository root, and `*` wildcards any field. A row without a reason,
# or with the wrong column count, fails the check rather than passing
# silently. A comment inside the caller's workflow does not silence anything;
# this file is the only exception path, so every exception is visible here.
# Empty: no estate workflow currently needs an unbounded install.
